fact: The National Single Registry, commissioned in February 2021, had 10 legacy programme MISs (including SAGE, NUSAF3, DRDIP, NSSF, YLP, UWEP) integrated and synchronised with its upgraded version 2 during June 2023 to August 2024, and it provides a gateway to NIRA for verification of applicants and beneficiaries, with the NIRA NIN Check API upgraded.
title: Maintenance of National Single Registry (NSR) Closing Report
publisher: Ministry of Gender, Labour & Social Development (MGLSD)
